recipe_version.title: Chinese Hot and Sour Soup with Tofu, Shiitake, and Egg Ribbons
recipe_version.description: Dried shiitake mushrooms, bamboo shoots, ginger, and firm tofu simmered in vegetable broth with soy sauce, thickened with cornstarch, swirled with egg ribbons, and sharpened with rice vinegar, white pepper, and toasted sesame oil, served with jasmine rice and scallions.

ingredients.name: vegetable broth
ingredients.display_name: vegetable broth whose label lists vegetables, salt, and spices

ingredients.name: bamboo shoots
ingredients.display_name: sliced bamboo shoots (one 8-oz can) whose label lists bamboo shoots, water, and citric acid

steps.title: Soak the shiitake
steps.body: Pour 2 cups hot tap water over the shiitake in the heatproof bowl and leave them to soften while the rice cooks (overlap, about 20 minutes). Rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice with 2 1/4 cups water and the salt in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Leave it covered off the heat to rest 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: While the rice cooks (overlap stated): lift out the shiitake, squeeze them over the bowl, and slice them thin, saving the soaking liquid. Cut the tofu and bamboo into strips, cut the ginger into matchsticks, beat the eggs, and slice the scallions.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: In the 4-quart pot combine the broth, the shiitake with 1 1/2 cups of their soaking water (leave any grit behind), the ginger, bamboo, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil over high, about 9 minutes to come to a boil, then simmer 5 minutes. Add the tofu and simmer 2 minutes.

steps.title: Thicken and swirl
steps.body: Stir the cornstarch into 1/4 cup water in the small bowl, stir it into the soup, and simmer until glossy, about 1 minute. Drizzle in the eggs in a thin stream while stirring slowly once around so they set in ribbons. Off the heat stir in the vinegar, white pepper, and sesame oil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Ladle the soup into bowls, scatter with scallions, and serve the rice alongside.
